description: a normal withdraw returns the remaining balance
an over-withdraw is rejected with -1 via checked_sub
a zero-amount withdraw is rejected with -2
a zero-amount withdraw from an empty vault is still the -2 rejection, not a 0 remainder
draining the vault to exactly zero is allowed
an over-withdraw by exactly 2 must be the -1 sentinel. A naive (balance as i128) - (amount as i128) yields -2 here, which is the ZERO-AMOUNT code: the sentinels are not arithmetic, they are decisions
withdrawing from an empty vault is an over-withdraw (-1), not a zero-amount rejection (-2): the guard is on the amount, never on the balance
a u64::MAX balance: the i128 return exists so the full u64 range survives the cast. Doing the subtraction in i64 wraps u64::MAX to -1 and returns -2
